mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and corporate earnings pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 5.0 and remains >5.0 for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE >5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in personal consumption expenditures (CPIAUCSL) below 2% annualized over six months signals weakening aggregate demand, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annualized change falls below 2% and remains <2% for 6 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL <2% for 6 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over three months signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.5% and remains >4.5% for 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS >4.5% for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).
